## CI red on 58be6ed5 · `Build & E2E UI` · this PR's

`ui/e2e/permission-field-panel-scroll.spec.ts:280` waits for the object row's expand button by the name `^Project\W*a_project\W*$` (label plus machine name). This PR draws the object row with its label only and moves the machine name to a tooltip (card item 5), so the button's accessible name is now `Project` and all three cases (1000 px, 720 px, CONTROL) time out at 30 s. Fix: the spec matches the label-only name. It goes in the fix round this PR already owes (the seat's claim amendment adds the `securityBlockWhere` hint in every locale pack plus the DraftChangesPanel default), with `ui/e2e/permission-field-panel-scroll.spec.ts` added to the claim surface (amendment on #34795).

## L1 review · 2026-11-17T17:28Z

L1: REWORK
Head-sha: 5ba8869eae5071fd62b39083d42c78fe498da0f1

This is the first L1 on this PR, a full read at this head:

- All 45 files (+728/−255) and the PR body (refreshed by the area at this head).
- The card #34795, claim 6947852041 (corrected 6947891818), seat amendment 6953806876 (`securityBlockWhere` in all packs plus the DraftChangesPanel default) and amendment 6954025940 (the e2e spec).
- Dev reports 6953660171 (round 1) and 6955585194 (round 2), the CI note 6954010434, and the check-runs on this sha.
- `check-governed-merges` on the final file list: not governed, 983 lines.

### Must-fix

**M1. A platform-checklist clause this PR makes false.** `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/studio-authoring.json:1019` (the read-only Access item's `verify`) still says:

> "the object row's bulk, which appears only on hover or keyboard focus (engine.studio.access.bulkHint), is disabled when it appears"

This PR draws the bulk strip on every row and deletes `engine.studio.access.bulkHint`. A QA runner following that clause hovers to make a strip appear that is now always there, and looks up a key that no longer exists. Restate it, for example: "every object row draws its bulk strip (All · Read only · None · Read & write), and in read-only Studio every button in it is disabled". Keep the FAIL condition (an operating bulk control), and add the file's own change record if its format asks for one.

`check-platform-checklist --changed-from` stays green because this item is anchored to no file in the diff, so only a text read finds it. The file sits outside the claimed surface and needs a one-line surface amendment from the seat. Line 1077, the historic change note, stays as it is.

### Should-fix

None.

### What holds (no action)

- **Shape:** draft, `Fixes #34795`. `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` appear in the body and the changeset. The claim predicted `yes (widening — locale keys only)`. The PR ships value edits plus the removal of one key that nothing reads (`check:i18n-keys` 0), and seat amendment 6953806876 confirms "`Clause-②: no` holds". So the line matches the claim as amended.
- **Scope:** every code path is in the claim plus the two amendments.
  - The `DraftChangesPanel.securityLink` / `.securityProblems` test edits (one assertion each, reading the renamed hint) are judged acceptable. They are readers of the amended default text.
  - `ObjectSettingsPanel*` and `DirectoryPage.stateVocabulary-29705` tests assert shared keys; the round-1 report declares them.
- **Changeset:** app-shell, i18n and console patches. Its text matches the diff, including the Setup reach through shared keys and the 11-pack hint.
- **Wording:** zh and en move together, value for value, across the OWD values, the four tabs, the suggestion lines, the overview and settings labels, and the bulk labels. The stored `sharingModel` values and every call are unchanged: the bulk buttons still call `onBulkSet` with the same four actions, and `suggestRevoke` keeps its handler. `securityBlockWhere` is moved in all 11 packs plus the default, and en grows +11 bytes against a 0.2 KB headroom.
- **e2e:** `permission-field-panel-scroll.spec.ts` matches `^Project$` on the Studio host only, and the Setup host keeps label-plus-name. The old-regex control reproduces the CI timeout.
- **Tests:** real commands with exit codes; 5 ablations, each red on its own case.

### Notes / nits

- **N1 (nit, pre-existing):** each row's bulk buttons are named only "All", "Read only" and so on, with no object in the accessible name. Now that every row draws them, a screen-reader user tabbing the matrix hears the same four names per row. An `aria-label` that carries the object's label would fix it. The names were the same before this PR, which only changes when the strip draws.
- **N2 (note, pre-existing):** the studio namespace exists only in en/zh, so a de/fr/… user sees the English "Who can see which records" in Settings, while the hint in their pack names a translated label. That mismatch predates this PR ("Datensatzfreigabe" vs "Record sharing (OWD)").
- **N3 (note):** `suggestConfirmedToast` no longer uses `{anchor}` ("Every member now has …"). That is safe because a guest suggestion cannot be confirmed here (`suggestGuestUnsupported`). If guest confirmation is ever added, the toast needs its guest twin.

### CI at review time

There are 61 check-runs on this sha, 0 failed. Build & E2E UI, Live E2E UI, Lint UI, Type Check UI and Test UI 1–8 and 10–16 are green. Test UI 9/16 is re-running after a checkout timeout. A second Check Changeset run started at 17:26Z, after the body edit. **Landing needs every run on the landing head green.**

### Routing

REWORK on M1 only, a single docs/qa clause. The seat amends the surface, the fix round edits the clause, and the delta L1 reads that commit. No L2 is owed (Clause-② no) and the PR is not governed.

### ⛔ merge queue 构建失败 — 先分诊，再决定要不要重排

队列构建 [44142383288](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/44142383288) 红了。队列跑的是**全量**套件（PR 侧 CI 只跑 affected 子集），
所以失败的测试可能在本 PR 没碰过的包里 —— 那不是重排能修的。每次盲目重排都会让排在后面的所有 PR 重建一轮。

**分类：`failure`** —— 按下面的日志分诊。

**失败的 job（日志抽取，best effort）：**

- **[Test UI (10/16)](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/44142383288/job/134250079846)** — 失败步骤: Fetch this commit's history and the base branch（日志不可读，点进 job 看）

> `↳ 失败原因` 是判读的关键：**超时**（`Test timed out in …` / `Hook timed out in …`）多半是负载/时序，不是本 PR 的回归；
> **断言**（`AssertionError: …`）才指向真实的行为改变。两者的 `FAIL` 行长得一模一样，只有这一行能区分。
>
> ⚠️ **断言这一侧有一类例外，判据是断言在测什么，不是它是不是 `AssertionError`。** 断言的对象是**产品行为**（一个值、一个形状、一次拒收）⇒ 照上面读：真实的行为改变，去查，⛔ 不要重排掉；
> 断言的对象是**这次实验自身的有效性前提**（跑完的耗时、负载下的先后、任何只在时间预算内才成立的条件）⇒ 它跟**超时**是同一类，同样对负载敏感，重排一次是合法的判别手段。
> 识别是机械的：断言的消息或它比较的值本身点名了一段**时长、一个时间戳、一个耗时计数**。实测过的一对 —— `AssertionError: SecurityPlugin.init() ran: expected false to be true` 测的是产品行为（真回归）；
> `AssertionError: this run took over a second, so second-precision stamps could have differed too: expected 1006 to be less than 1000` 测的是实验前提：它守护的那条不变式当时是绿的，同一个 head 原样重排一次即成功。
> 穿着 `AssertionError` 外衣的时间测量，仍然是时间测量。（⛔ 这只改「怎么读一次红」，不改「哪些测试可以重排」——后者由别处管。）

**跨 PR 相同签名（24h，按失败测试文件聚合）：**

- ⚠️ **本次没有可用的聚合签名**（日志里没有能解析出测试文件名的 FAIL 行）—— 这不是「没有同签名的其他 PR」，是**这一轮没测到**。跨 PR 聚合本次不可用，请手工比对其他 PR 的同类评论。
- ⚠️ 24h 评论账本**没读完**（超过 5 页仍未读到窗口尽头），所以上面的「不同 PR 数」是**下界**，不是全量。

**历史信号：**
- 本 PR 过去 24h 无队列失败记录（首次）。
- 过去 24h 队列共有 34 个失败构建（不含本次）。

**分诊清单：**
1. 失败测试在本 PR 改动的包里 → 真回归，修 PR。
2. 失败测试与本 PR 无关 → 看上面的「跨 PR 相同签名」；已有汇总 issue ⇒ flaky/环境问题实锤，去那张 issue 上谈，修好前重排只会再烧一轮全队列。
3. 两者都不是 → 可能与同组 PR 语义冲突；等前面的 PR 落地或失败出队后再重排一次即可，不要连续重排。
